How AI can help job seekers

AI can help organise parts of a job search, from clarifying a role’s requirements to practising interview answers. It cannot verify every vacancy or replace your judgement about an opportunity.

Updated 2026-10-07 · FaceMeX

Turn a broad search into a plan

Set role, location, schedule and experience criteria. Track where you found each vacancy and when you checked it, so you can revisit the original source before applying.

Tailor materials without inventing experience

An AI tool can help compare a CV with a job description or improve clarity. Keep all claims accurate, include only skills you can support and proofread every generated change.

Practise interview communication

Generate practice questions based on the role and rehearse examples drawn from your real experience. Use feedback to improve clarity, not to memorise answers that do not sound like you.

Watch for scams and outdated listings

Confirm the employer and vacancy through an official channel. Be cautious about upfront fees, pressure to act immediately, requests for passwords or sensitive information, and application domains that do not match the organisation.

Know the limits

AI can make errors and job data can change. FaceMeX does not guarantee an interview or job. Verify deadlines, requirements and application destinations independently.
